status: bounded static contract; sealed local evidence; no target runtime comparison

tooling.method: isolated original-address raw slices, retained REA analysis/readback/snapshots and canonical import

claims.claim: PArrangement restores a typed MRoot followed immediately by a typed PArrangeSetup and installs the arrangement adjusted rate interface on that root.
details: Root result is stored at arrangement+108, setup result at+110; null either causes a failed read.
Root+128 receives arrangement+40, root+130 receives arrangement+48. Concrete primary/adjusted table bindings and RTTI are rechecked in verification.json.
PArrangement v4 then reads seven length-prefixed strings: three from version>=1 and four from version>=4. Version2 has another branch, outside this parser.

claims.claim: The native reader stores the serialized Float32 base at configuration+ac and, from version2, serialized Float64 factor at+b0. The writer emits those exact fields.
details: Complete forward versioned order is field-schema.json; neither general setup extent nor later offsets are fixed because embedded datum forms and strings vary.
With the concrete installed provider and unchanged stored values, root getter10171c5a0 reaches1009573dc: RN64(Double(baseFloat32) * factorFloat64).
This binds saved configuration to the same provider used by the builder. It does not establish current device/engine/global period equality.

claims.claim: Native base-rate fallback is a specific floating-point branch, not finite validation; missing setup is not a saved44100 value.
details: For ordered input outside inclusive[10000,1024000], native writes Float32 bits472c4400=44100. Inclusive bounds remain unchanged.

FCMP then FCCMP conditionPL with false flags0, then B.LE skips the fallback. Unordered NaN follows the skip path; positive/negative infinity take fallback. Thirteen analytical flag controls retain this distinction.
Raw Ghidra pseudocode rewrites the first comparison in a way that changes NaN behavior. Original instructions govern this claim.

Factor has no local finite/range guard. Versions below2 explicitly store Double+1. Config/owner absent fallbacks in getters are separate from PArrangement read failure and cannot become recovered saved state.

claims.claim: Scalar embedded datums and inline file-type/string framing are concretely bound, supporting an exact forward v8 parser.
details: Embedded object readers101c25998/write101c259d8 use a Double coordinate then tagged datum reader101c23184/writer101c23368. Tags1/10 have i32 tag plus Double scalar, total20 bytes including coordinate. Tags0/17 can carry interface objects and context-sensitive coercion; authored subset rejects them.
Inline FFileType concrete vtable104e45588 reader10319b8b8 consumes i32 plus three length-prefixed strings. No archive object header surrounds this inline member.

String helper103109ff0 consumes signed count, handles zero and optional leading/trailing UTF8 BOM. Authored parser rejects negative/over50000 lengths and requires strict UTF8/terminal NUL for nonempty carriers; native has additional permissive paths.
Format token reader10221e70c has ten-byte limit and NUL/newline/CR handling. Authored subset admits printableASCII with a NUL within ten bytes only. Native writer10221e6c4 includes the terminal NUL.

claims.claim: All ten pinned factory CPRs structurally expose a direct version8 setup with saved base44100 and exactfactor+1.
details: Each reached PArrangementv4 contains an explicit MRootv6 then explicit PArrangeSetupv8; no positive root/setup reference occurs in these fixtures. All arrangement/ARCH/setup extents consume exactly.
Each factory setup body is169bytes; base atbody+48 andfactor atbody+92 in these scalar fixtures. The three file-type strings and token lengths are observations, not universal offsets.
Every embedded datum is tag1 with scalar+1. Configuration base/factor are source observations independent of metadata MusicalTempo and source media sample rates.
Thirty synthetic parser controls challenge variable-length strings, datum tags, token/framing limits and truncation. They validate the instrument, not Cubase runtime acceptance.

claims.claim: Post-read host effects remain a bounded interpretation boundary.
details: Config helper100965f54 resolves PAudioDevice registry results and updates/copies file-type state and index+160; no direct store to+ac/+b0 appears in its inspected body. Registry targets can have external effects.
PArrangement callback100956f80 invokes registry/global callbacks and root+538→10171e9fc. Inspected local writes concern root/cache/flags, with nested callbacks still conditional.

The finding supports exact saved fields and a fresh reconstruction consuming them. It does not assert that all native hosted states remain equal to saved values, registry replacements cannot occur, or playback/export matches Cubase.

claims.claim: A defensible initial playback subset can use explicit saved base and exactfactor+1 without emulating malformed/defaulted native state.
details: Require typed forward PArrangementv4/MRootv6/PArrangeSetupv8, supported scalar tags and complete bounded extents; do not scan for a setup class name or infer from media.

Retain raw rate/factor bits including unsupported values; admission is separate. Proposed application domain is finite integral10000..192000 base with exactDouble+1 factor. This upper bound and strict parsing are application limits, not inferred full native capabilities.

Missing setup, unresolved object references, other versions, malformed strings, nonfinite/out-of-domain rate or nonunity factor remain explicitly unsupported. No44100 fallback is promoted to saved source authority.

review.scope: Independent peer original/schema/core review is external and not part of this seal.

remaining: No target launch, re-save, export, playback or device comparison.
No general archive identity/reference recovery inside opaque MRoot in this focused probe.
Older/future setup versions are not authored parser admission; callback/environment effects after restore remain conditional.
